end.summary:
- Practised plotting points from ordered pairs (x, y).
- Practised identifying quadrants from coordinate signs.
- Harsh correctly identified points on the y-axis when x = 0.
- Harsh corrected the order/direction mix-up: x controls left-right and y controls up-down.
- Harsh still treated (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point once; this was not corrected later.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised reading ordered pairs, plotting points, and matching coordinate signs to quadrants. They used the method that x gives left-right movement and y gives up-down movement, and later explained that changing only x changes left-right while keeping up-down the same. There was one mix-up about (3, 2) and (2, 3) being the same point, which was not revisited. At home, ask Harsh to plot both points on squared paper and describe how their positions differ.
